bottleneck.summary: Tc2RuRe→Tc3Re three-tolerance map gives +.0587…+.1194 lambda and Tc+1.089 K, plus an additional two-tolerance TcRe response. Path0, force0 and .282 GPa stress support local source phase. Binary Tc-Re phase competition and radioactive/SOC approximations remain explicit.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.002 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.10600000000000001 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.
unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Ru-to-Tc mapped role substitution in Tc3Re. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare exact Tc3Re SG139 mode/orbital response with retained Ru-containing parent and closest Tc-Re competing order. Favorable: distinct local role gain remains; adverse: phase/channel competition eliminates it; ambiguous: geometry/energy comparison not available.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
